messages:
Hannah (Marketing): quick ask — need a compact benchpack for the launch: hero diagram (web+print), 2 webinar slides, 1-pager PDF, 4 social tiles (square+story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. deadline Tue EOD (2026-04-07). who can take this?

Jules (Design): I can. file specs? preferred copy? logos?

Hannah (Marketing): specs: hero web 1400x800, print 8.5x11 PDF, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email 600x200, SVG ids for mapping. copy: short headlines only — i'll drop strings in Drive. logos: only whitelist per Legal.

Sam (Product): numbers uploaded to Drive: p50=42ms, p95=120ms, cost=$0.007/1k tokens. included README: "measured in internal testbeds; not an SLA."

Nina (Marketing Ops): for HubSpot SVG please include element ids like id=form-email id=segment-webinar id=sfdc-lead so i can map fields.

Legal (Legal): approved — do not use customer logos without written consent. when referencing performance, use qualifiers (e.g., "benchmarked", "measured in our testbeds").

Jules (Design): plan: WIP Mon morning, final Tue afternoon. will export EN masters with editable text layers for FR/DE handoff and include SVGs with ids. will upload to Drive and tag @Hannah.

Hannah (Marketing): perfect — thanks. I'll run a quick brand check on the WIP and loop Legal if needed.
